title: Earthquake aftershock sleep layout
summary: Reduces night injury risk after an earthquake when aftershocks are expected.
content: Earthquake aftershock sleep layout is a practical offline routine for earthquake shelter. Move beds away from windows, mirrors, tall furniture, shelves, hanging objects, and cracked walls if the building is safe. Place shoes, flashlight, glasses, medicine, and go-bag where they can be reached without stepping on glass. Keep doors and exit paths clear and set a no-elevator rule after shaking. Agree on an outside meeting point. Sleep in clothing suitable for fast exit and weather.
steps: Agree on an outside meeting point.
Sleep in clothing suitable for fast exit and weather.
